purpose: First trainable release built only from images whose full frame passed six-class annotation review. Used to measure real held-out mAP and find which classes need more data. It does NOT satisfy the r1 policy in release_policy.json (>=1000 training images per class), which stays unchanged. r2: adds source_balance so every class/source with enough positives keeps >=50% in train and contributes ~15% to each of val and test (whole units only). r3: river-monitoring cameras that look down at a stream from a bank, bridge or lock (no horizon in view) are train-only, like aerial views; the deployment camera looks across open water.
train_only_reason: Aerial/unknown views are not the deployment domain. IALA10 images are close-up buoy crops from re-published web photos; they help training but would make held-out marker AP look easier than real boat/shore scenes.
near_duplicate_rule: Capture groups linked by a visually confirmed cross-group duplicate are merged into one split unit. Candidate pairs come from 24x24 RGB thumbnail correlation and dHash; see reports/pilot_r0/near_duplicates.json.
train_only_groups_reason: Viewed 2026-10-27: each site is a fixed camera pointed down at a small river or canal lock, no horizon; not the boat/shore deployment view. Applied to every image of these sites, all classes.
